extracted.name: Rainbow prawn cocktails
extracted.description: Serve this Asian-inspired twist on classic prawn cocktail as a starter or party canapés over the festive period
ingredient_lines: 3 tsp sriracha or other chilli sauce
½ large cucumber peeled into ribbons
instruction_lines: For the pickles, put the vinegar, 50ml water, the sugar and 2 tsp sea salt in a pan and simmer for 5 mins over a medium heat, stirring until the sugar and salt have dissolved. Leave to cool a little. Put the vegetables in a bowl and pour over the pickling liquid. Leave in the fridge for at least 1 hr.

Mix together the mayonnaise, lime juice, sriracha and pickled ginger. Arrange the lettuce leaves in six bowls, then top with the pickled veg, prawns and sauce. Finish with spring onions, sesame seeds and prawn crackers.
